analysis_status: exploratory fixed local protocol; not public preregistration
research_question: Does a fixed filter bank improve source-only four-class LOSO decoding relative to broadband multiclass CSP?
hypothesis: Frequency-specific spatial filters may outperform one broadband spatial transform; improvement is not assumed.

evaluation.target_information: No target-subject parameter estimation or model selection; per-trial fixed transform only
evaluation.tuning: none; all options fixed before running this experiment
evaluation.primary_population: all trials including expert artifact flags
evaluation.aggregation: subject-equal mean and sample SD; descriptive contrasts only

limitations: Not an exact reproduction of Ang 2012 FBCSP: MNE multiclass joint diagonalization, Butterworth zero-phase filtering, LDA and no paired MI feature retention.
MI8 is a dimension-reduction sensitivity, not a perfect capacity-matched comparison.
Offline zero-phase run filtering is not a causal online pipeline.
BNCI2014_001 has already informed pilot exploration; these are not independent confirmatory results.
